The Senior Director of Human Resources and People Strategy serves as the senior HR advisor and strategic partner for the Betty Irene Moore School of Nursing, providing leadership across workforce strategy, organizational effectiveness, compensation and classification, and complex employee and labor relations. Reporting to the Executive Director of Finance and Administration, the Senior Director partners with the Dean, School leadership, and institutional partners to develop people strategies that advance the School’s education, research, clinical, community engagement, and administrative missions.
40% - Strategic Workforce Planning, HR Programs, and Organizational Effectiveness

Operating within a complex academic, clinical, and research environment, the Senior Director advises leaders on workforce planning, organizational design and change, compensation, employee and labor relations, talent and retention strategies, and HR risk mitigation. The position anticipates workforce needs, develops solutions to complex issues, and leads initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness and the employee experience.
30% - Academic and Staff Compensation and Classification Strategy

The Senior Director serves as the School’s primary strategic HR partner to Central Campus Human Resources and collaborates with Academic Personnel, Labor Relations, Compensation, Legal, Compliance, and other institutional partners to ensure effective and consistent HR practices. The position also provides oversight, direction, coaching, and development to HR professionals, establishes HR priorities and process improvements, and promotes effective resource stewardship and HR data integrity.
30% - Employee and Labor Relations

Strong decision-making, analytical, problem-solving, critical thinking, resource management, consultation, negotiation, mediation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, writing, coaching, facilitation, influence, and relationship-management skills.
